source.reviewRequirement: Inspect actual commits and diff files. Include only real user-facing changes shown by code and release/deploy evidence. Internal refactors are not user-facing releases.

schedule.publisher: scheduled ChatGPT agent, not GitHub Actions (avoid duplicates)

activation.note: This is the verified scheduled-task state on 2026-10-28; task activation is outside GitHub and must be rechecked before future status claims.

output.message: One concise factual Tajik product update, not technical commit log

image.theme: Original HSK AI branded topical artwork, clean readable layout, no invented screenshot; media must have HTTPS URL accepted by Zernio

designPolicy.principle: Restrained, elegant, human-art-directed editorial product/news art, not AI-generated ad collage or an infographic.

focalElements.description: One or two main visual objects only, strictly related to verified news.

supportingDetails.description: A few subtle supporting details only where needed; generous whitespace and one visual hierarchy.

typography.headlineAllowed: At most one short, large, correctly typeset 2–5-word heading only if it adds meaning.
typography.captionDuplication: Never repeat the Telegram caption/message or information already clearly expressed in the caption.
prohibited: invented Chinese characters or book-cover text

designPolicy.onFailure: Regenerate or simplify before publication; do not compromise factual or media-hosting requirements.

mediaHosting.rationale: Adobe-generated preview/share/session HTTPS URLs can return 404 to Zernio; a real raw image file must be hosted and independently validated before publication.
mediaHosting.branchPolicy: Create a unique media/telegram-news-YYYYMMDD-unique branch from the current main SHA for each distinct image. Never alter main, existing files, historical posts, lesson/video code or agent scripts. No duplicate GitHub publishing cron.

fileRequirements.source: Only the newly generated factual news image, not an old/irrelevant placeholder

uploadSteps: Obtain the newly generated image's ACTUAL binary bytes, not an Adobe share/session/preview URL or a markdown image link.

For GitHub Git data API use create_blob with encoding=base64 containing genuine PNG/JPEG bytes; create_tree with the binary blob's SHA and exact file path, create_commit on the isolated media branch, update_ref with the expected branch SHA. A create_file UTF-8 string is NOT a binary image upload.
Build the immutable raw.githubusercontent.com URL from the created image COMMIT SHA and exact path, not a guessed branch URL or a github.com/.../blob HTML page.
Verify remote GET returns HTTP 200, a real image/png or image/jpeg payload with matching dimensions (4:3) and nonzero file size; check Zernio validate_media or validate_post accepts it.
Post only the validated original image plus verified Tajik Cyrillic news text to the exact authorized Telegram account via Zernio, read back published status and deduplicate.
prohibited: Adobe session/share/preview URLs as post media
writing binary content with text-only create_file
altering main branch while archiving media
posting text only when an image was required
mediaHosting.onHostingFailure: Skip public Telegram post, give exact blocker, do not retry publishing without checking Zernio's recent posts first.
mediaHosting.verificationNote: On 2026-10-28 an already committed public PNG in this GitHub repository passed Zernio's read-only validate_media check. This verifies GitHub RAW HOST compatibility only; it does not verify a future agent can acquire generated image bytes, upload them or complete a Telegram post.

output.publication: Automatic after positive evidence; skip if no real update

safety.deduplication: Inspect Telegram published-post history for same source commits in last three days; don't repost
safety.missingPhotoOrAccount: Do not post text-only, video or to another platform; report error and block
safety.readback: Confirm Zernio post has the exact Telegram account and published status; record URL and source SHA
safety.publicationProof: An enabled schedule is not proof of a published Telegram post; verify each actual Zernio post.
